visual_logic.surface_detail: Interlocking dermal ossicles along the spine rendered as smooth, rounded 'toy-like' armor plates, fully visible along its top horizontal ridge line.
visual_logic.environment: Blue-green caldera lake water with suspended volcanic ash particles restricted entirely to background layers to keep the silhouette sharp.
visual_logic.color_palette: Cool grey skin with 'Purple-gray' highlights on the tail fin, mapped cleanly across its horizontal lateral flank.

pose: The unique marine reptile is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original vertical breaching pose is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level cruising path, extending its toothless bird-like beak, armor-plated torso, flippers, and distinct tail fin end-to-end to trace flawlessly alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
